biography.value:
觀察者是一種用儀式從其他存在位面召喚來的低階眼魔，其儀式的法術成分需要用四根眼魔眼柄作耗材。而觀察者眼魔剛好長着四根眼柄在其四尺直徑的身軀兩側每邊兩個。

    魔法守護者Magical Guardians。被召來的觀察者眼魔會爲其召喚者對指定位置或寶藏進行爲期101年的守護工作。期間它會阻止召喚者以外的任何生物進入該位置，或是使用該物品。除非召喚者另有指示，否則觀察者眼魔絕不會背棄自己的職責。如果所守護物品在年限到來之前被偷竊或遭摧毀，觀察者眼魔也隨之消失。

    輕微瘋症Glimmers of Madness。觀察者眼魔可以說話，但是它更喜歡以心靈感應的方式進行交流。它在擔任守護任務時還算稱職，甚至還會跟人談論它的職責和它的召喚者。有時候，甚至可以通過與其簡單的交談就能夠揭示它多年獨居生活養成的一些怪癖。比如它可能會有假想敵，用第三人稱看待自己，或是模仿其召喚者的嗓音。

   觀察者眼魔跟普通眼魔一樣視其自身爲其種族中的楷模，並且對其他觀察者眼魔懷有強烈的恨意。如果兩隻觀察者發生遭遇通常都會導致兩者爆發殊死的搏鬥。

從使命中解脫Freed from Service。觀察者眼魔完成其使命後就可自由去做自己的事情了。它們大多會選擇住在曾經看守的地點，尤其是其召喚者已經死亡的情況下更是如此。失去使命的觀察者眼魔，其在勞役時期養成的輕微瘋症會逐漸變得更加嚴重。    

A spectator is a lesser beholder that is summoned from another plane of existence by a magical ritual, the components of which include four beholder eyestalks that are consumed by the ritual's magic. Appropriately, a spectator has four eyestalks, two on each side of the wide eye at the center of its four-foot diameter body.

Magical Guardians. A summoned spectator guards a location or a treasure of its summoner's choice for 101 years, allowing no creature but its summoner to enter the area or access the item, unless the summoner instructed otherwise. If the item is stolen or destroyed before the years have all passed, a summoned spectator vanishes. It otherwise never abandons its post.

Glimmers of Madness. Though it can speak, a spectator communicates primarily by way of telepathy. It is civil while on guard, openly discussing its orders and its summoner. However, even a brief conversation with a spectator is enough to reveal quirks in its personality brought on by its years of isolation. It might invent imaginary enemies, refer to itself in the third person, or try to adopt the voice of its summoner.

Like any beholder, a spectator views itself as the epitome of its kind, and it has an intense hatred of other spectators. If two spectators encounter one another, they almost always fight to the death.

Freed from Service. When a spectator has fulfilled its service, it is free to do as it pleases. Many take up residence in the places they previously guarded, especially if their summoners have died. With the spectator's loss of purpose, the flickers of madness it displayed during its servitude flourish.

description.value:
近戰武器攻擊：命中+1，觸及5尺，單一目標。命中：2（1d6-1）點穿刺傷害

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+1]]{+1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 ([[/damage 1d6 - 1 type=piercing]]) damage.

觀察者眼魔從下列選項中選擇發射兩束魔法眼波射線，並指定身邊90尺內它可以看到的一到兩個目標。每種射線觀察者在一回閤中只能使用一次：

  • @UUID[.hrPz5yXP4U1kLHrN]{1. 困惑射線}
  • @UUID[.qt9pKtneIiSrIIUo]{2. 麻痹射線}
  • @UUID[.oarG6Hq7ZGYl7aPf]{3. 恐懼射線}
  • @UUID[.mwaIyiuWovQM3NSI]{4. 致傷射線}

The spectator shoots up to two of the following magical eye rays at one or two creatures it can see within 90 feet of it. It can use each ray only once on a turn.

  • @UUID[.hrPz5yXP4U1kLHrN]{1. Confusion Ray}
  • @UUID[.qt9pKtneIiSrIIUo]{2. Paralyzing Ray}
  • @UUID[.oarG6Hq7ZGYl7aPf]{3. Fear Ray}
  • @UUID[.mwaIyiuWovQM3NSI]{4. Wounding Ray}

items.name: 眼波射線：1. 困惑射線Eye Rays: 1. Confusion Ray

description.value:
目標必須進行一次DC 13的感知豁免，豁免失敗者直至其下回合結束前都無法執行任何反應。該生物在其自己回合中將無法移動，並使用其動作對可及範圍內隨機的某個生物發動一次近戰或遠程攻擊。如果受術目標無法攻擊，則其在自己回合中什麼都不做。

The target must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=13]] saving throw, or it can't take reactions until the end of its next turn. On its turn, the target can't move, and it uses its action to make a melee or ranged attack against a randomly determined creature within range. If the target can't attack, it does nothing on its turn.

items.name: 眼波射線：2. 麻痹射線Eye Rays: 2. Paralyzing Ray

description.value:
目標必須進行一次DC 13的體質豁免，豁免失敗者將陷入1分鐘的麻痹。該目標可以在每個其自己回合結束時再進行一次該豁免，豁免成功則終止該效應。

The target must succeed on a [[/save ability=con dc=13]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=paralyzed] for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 眼波射線：3. 恐懼射線Eye Rays: 3. Fear Ray

description.value:
目標必須進行一次DC 13的感知豁免，豁免失敗者將陷入1分鐘的恐慌狀態。該目標可以在每個其自己回合結束時再進行一次該豁免，豁免成功則終止該效應。

The target must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=13]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=frightened] for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the spectator is visible to the target, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 眼波射線：4. 致傷射線Eye Rays: 4. Wounding Ray

description.value:
目標必須進行一次DC 13的體質豁免，豁免失敗者將受到16（3d10）點黯蝕傷害，豁免成功則傷害減半。

The target must make a [[/save ability=con dc=13]] saving throw, taking 16 ([[/damage 3d10 type=necrotic]]) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

觀察者眼魔以魔法制造足夠維持自己24小時供給的食物和飲用水。

The spectator magically creates enough food and water to sustain itself for 24 hours.

如果觀察者眼魔通過了對法術的豁免檢定，或者對其發動的法術攻擊未命中時，它可指定身邊30尺範圍內一個它能看見的其他生物（包括施法者），使那個生物代替觀察者眼魔作爲該法術的目標。如果該法術迫使目標進行豁免檢定，則被指定的生物必須自行進行豁免。若該法術發動一次攻擊，則該法術必須對被指定生物重擲攻擊檢定。

If the spectator makes a successful saving throw against a spell, or a spell attack misses it, the spectator can choose another creature (including the spellcaster) it can see within 30 feet of it. The spell targets the chosen creature instead of the spectator. If the spell forced a saving throw, the chosen creature makes its own save. If the spell was an attack, the attack roll is rerolled against the chosen creature.
